faq.title: Everything You Need Here
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about buying, financing, and owning with Nexus Auto.
faq.q1: What financing options do you offer?
faq.a1: We offer flexible leasing, hire purchase, and premium financing through trusted banking partners.
faq.q2: Can I trade in my current vehicle?
faq.a2: Yes. Our trade-in appraisal is transparent, fast, and applied directly toward your next purchase.
faq.a3: Every vehicle includes a comprehensive inspection report and optional extended warranty packages.
faq.q4: How do I schedule a test drive?
faq.a4: Contact our sales team or book online — we arrange private viewings at your convenience.
faq.a5: Premium delivery is available within the city and nationwide for select inventory.

contact_page.description: Curated luxury vehicles from the world's most prestigious brands. Our team is ready to answer your questions today.
contact_page.showroom_desc: Experience our curated collection in person. Visit our showroom, meet the team, and explore the vehicles firsthand.
contact_page.faq_desc: Quick answers to common questions about visiting our showroom, booking appointments, and getting in touch with our team.
contact_page.faq_a1: Our showroom is open from Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.
contact_page.faq_q2: Do I Need an Appointment to Visit?
contact_page.faq_a2: While walk-ins are always welcome, we highly recommend booking an appointment so we can assign a dedicated specialist to assist you.
contact_page.faq_q3: How Quickly Will You Respond to My Enquiry?
contact_page.faq_a3: We strive to respond to all enquiries within 2-4 business hours during our standard operating times.
contact_page.faq_q4: Can I Schedule a Test Drive Through the Contact Form?
contact_page.faq_a4: Yes, absolutely. Just select 'Test Drive' from the service dropdown and mention your preferred date and time in the message box.
contact_page.faq_q5: Is Parking Available at Your Showroom?
contact_page.faq_a5: Yes, we offer complimentary valet parking for all our visitors right at the front entrance of our showroom.
